After the purchase and before the sale

More than buying or selling

GRENFORD’s building blocks can be combined depending on the project. You keep one point of contact, even when several areas are involved.

  • Buy and renovateProperty Brief+Financing via partners+Renovation Memo

    Purchase price, financing and renovation costs are on the table before you sign, with costs from original quotes rather than estimates.

  • Buy an investment propertyProperty Brief+Valuation+Financing via partners

    Rent, service charge, reserves and financing in one calculation, plus the value today and after a modernisation.

  • SellValuation+Renovation Memo+Property Brief

    First know the value in its current condition and after a refresh, then plan the route to the buyer.

  • After moving inRenovation Memo

    Bathroom, kitchen or energy-efficiency upgrade with comparable quotes from construction firms in the GRENFORD network.

Financing: GRENFORD works with independent mortgage brokers and with banks and puts you in touch on request. The financing advice itself is provided by these partners.

Partner network: For energy consulting, experts and construction firms, GRENFORD draws on partners it works with regularly.

What you hold in your hands at the end

A written Property Brief: figures, options and open points on a few pages, so you can also discuss it with family, bank or tax adviser.

Frequently asked questions

Is discreet marketing possible?＋

Yes. The first conversation clarifies whether public marketing or a targeted, discreet approach is the better fit.

Is my enquiry already a search mandate?＋

No. You first share your interest in buying. An individual search mandate is discussed separately if needed and agreed in writing.

Who pays the agent’s commission?＋

When flats and single-family houses are sold to private buyers in Germany, the commission has been split under §§ 656c and 656d BGB since December 2020: buyers pay at most as much as the seller, and only once the seller has paid their share. The amount is fixed for every property before the viewing.

Do you also advise private buy-to-let investors?＋

Yes. Let flats raise different questions from owner-occupation: tenancy agreement and rent level, service charges and non-recoverable costs, maintenance reserve, owners’ meeting resolutions and rent-law limits. These points are covered in the Property Brief.
